messages:
alex: Heads-up — deploying a demo tomorrow and the EU h100 quota in our billed account shows 0 available. I requested quota increase last week but console still shows 0. Anyone seen this discrepancy? :eyes:

infra-bot: Ticket #INF-4821 opened with cloud vendor, ETA 48-72h. Auto-scaling will temporarily prefer us-west2.

maria: @alex can you paste output of `gcloud compute reservations list --project=redwood-prod --filter="region:(europe-west1 OR europe-west4) AND machineType:h100"`? Quick check: I saw a reservation in eu-west1 but it was in PENDING.

alex: pasted below — thanks
```
NAME          REGION       STATUS
h100-resv-1   europe-west4 PENDING
demo-pool     europe-west1 ACTIVE
```

ron: PENDING == vendor-side approval. Last time that cleared after they processed the invoice. I can ping procurement. If we don't get it, can we fall back to a mixed a500/a100 pool for the demo? would that cause perf regress?

sophie: Perf will drop ~15-25% for the H100 workload on A100 mix, but latency still within demo SLO if we reduce batch size. Suggest plan A: keep trying for H100, plan B: temp dedicated a100 pool + quantization flag. I can open a small dedicated pool for the demo window (2h) if procurement approves.

alex: thanks. @ron can you ping procurement + include invoice link? I'll update the runbook.

ron: pinged procurement (PR #2376) — included invoice and justification. procurement said vendor processing queue is 1-2 business days.

maria: To unblock tests I spun up a tiny a100 canary in eu-west4 (`gcloud compute instances create demo-canary --machine-type=n1-standard-8 --accelerator=type=nvidia-a100,count=1 --zone=europe-west4-a`). Using it for smoke tests only.

alex: Perfect. Can we also add a short note in the demo docs: "If H100 unavailable, use canary a100 with --batch-size 1"? I'll do the PR tonight.

sophie: I'll prepare a fallback config and attach to the runbook. Also added a monitoring alert to notify if queue depth increases >50% so we can re-evaluate.

alex: timeline check — if procurement doesn't clear by 09:00 tomorrow, we'll pivot to plan B. Thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary teardown in 4 hours. Use `gcloud compute instances delete demo-canary --zone=europe-west4-a` to keep or it will auto-delete.
